title: Layout composer for tidyplots
text: goal tidylayouts streamline creation multi-plot layouts scientific papers. allows gradually expand adjust layouts using consistent intuitive syntax. tidylayouts built around pipe supports plots absolute dimensions, created tidyplots, well plain ggplot2 plots. title: Lay out plots from a design string — layout_plots
text: ... ggplots, grobs layouts, order described . Lists spliced. design string one line per row cells. arrange_by blocks without spanning plots built: "row" (default, one row per design line), "column" (one column per design column) "grid" (shared rows columns). tags Panel tags, layout_tags(): "", "", "1", "", "" character vector. NULL (default) adds tags. stretch_x, stretch_y Letters plots whose panel stretches available width height (see stretch_x()), e.g. "EF". center_x, center_y Letters plots keep panel size centered available width height (see center_x()).

title: Lay out plots from a design string — layout_plots
text: Design. line design row cells, character cell: letter one plot. plot may cover several cells, must form rectangle. Uppercase lowercase letters different plots. # empty cell. design describes arrangement, size: plots keep panel sizes, also span several cells. let plot fill space spans, list stretch_x stretch_y (center center_x/center_y). Designs split along full rows columns (e.g. pinwheel) supported. Arrangement. design split along full rows columns plot crosses. Blocks plots without spanning plots built according arrange_by. "row" (default), line design becomes row(), "AB\nCD" row(, B) |> add_below(row(C, D)): line laid . "column", design column becomes column(). "grid", block becomes grid(), plots row column design share lines. Plot order. Plots ... assigned alphabetical order letters: Z, z. Tags. letters place plots. Tags numbered reading order, layout_tags(). let several plots share one tag, pass tag_group(), e.g. layout_plots(tag_group(p1, p2), p3, ...). result normal layout, can extended adjusted add_right(), layout_spacing() etc.

title: Layout options — layout_size
text: layout_size() sets figure size mm, e.g. journal column width (Nature: 89 mm single column, 183 mm double column). Free panels absorb extra space; none, becomes slack placed according containers' alignment. layout_spacing() sets gaps neighbouring plots mm, measured outer boxes (axis labels, legends tags included). replaces plots' plot.margin, gaps even plots use different themes. Without , gaps come plot margins. outer adds margin around whole figure. Note axis labels can stick past panel (e.g. last tick label); ggplot2 normally relies plot margin space. small gaps, labels may overlap neighbouring plots, figure's edge can cut ; use small outer margin (1-2 mm) . layout_tags() adds panel tags. Tags aligned top row, even plots row different heights. let several plots share one tag, use tag_group(). layout_title() adds title figure.

title: tidylayouts (development version)
text: New layout engine built ggplot2 grid; longer depends ggalign. Plots aligned panel edges, also across nested rows columns. row(), column() grid() gain horizontal_align vertical_align (defaults "left" "bottom"). place container’s direct plots; nested rows, columns grids fill space use alignment. grid() shares row column tracks. New layout_plots() builds layout design string, e.g. "ABEF\nCDEF\nGGGG". Letters place plots; default design line becomes row (arrange_by = "row"), alternatively column grid. Tags numbered reading order, tag_group() works inputs. Plots keep sizes; stretch_x, stretch_y, center_x center_y change listed plots. add_right() add_below() append row column direction wrap everything else. New stretch_x() stretch_y() let plot’s panel stretch spare space next ; center_x() center_y() keep panel size center plot space. Panel sizes set plot tidyplots::adjust_size() theme(panel.widths, panel.heights). New tag_group() lets several plots share one panel tag. New save_layout() saves figure exact physical size. layout_tags() aligns tags top row; layout_size() sets figure size mm. spacer() without size now absorbs leftover space. Plot backgrounds drawn plots, axis labels sticking past plot longer covered neighbouring plot’s background. layout_spacing(inner, outer) now sets gaps plots mm (one value, c(horizontal, vertical)), replacing plots’ margins, plus optional outer margin around figure. Removed layout_alignment(); use horizontal_align vertical_align.
